subject: Engineering Fundamentals
title: Isambard Kingdom Brunel: The Engineer Who Built Everything
description: One-minute skill: Isambard Kingdom Brunel: The Engineer Who Built Everything.

hook.text: One man built the longest tunnel, the widest bridge, and the biggest ship — all before age 53.

buildup.text: Brunel designed the Great Western Railway, making London to Bristol a two-hour journey.

discovery.text: His ship, the SS Great Eastern, was six times larger than any vessel ever built. It laid the first transatlantic cable.

twist.text: Many of his projects nearly bankrupted their investors. Brunel cared about engineering, not profit margins.

climax.text: He died at 53, exhausted from overwork. In 2002, Britons voted him the second greatest Briton ever.

punchline.text: He built the impossible. It just cost a fortune.

quiz.question: What record-breaking feat did Brunel's SS Great Eastern accomplish?
options: It was the first ship to cross the Atlantic without sails
It was six times larger than any ship ever built and laid the first transatlantic cable
It was the first ship made entirely of steel
